segments.text: Ok so, this is the voice and multimodal input page in the CopilotKit docs, for AG2 with Angular, and I have implemented this page.
So this is my project, this is the code from the doc, the chat with attachments, and the runtime server.
Moving on to the demo. So I attached a chart and asked about it, and the agent read the title and the Q4 value fine. But umm, there's no mic button in the chat at all.
Back on the doc. It says follow the voice backend setup, and that link just goes to a backend section on this same page, uh, which doesn't exist.
So attachments work, but voice can't be set up. The transcription route is never shown anywhere, so the runtime reports transcription disabled, and the chat hides the mic.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
